subject: reasoning
question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abc696a6e18604d27ef56a97b4cf9293fa9d40ccdc881e39fe0f2ae3a3fec54e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Element with arrow-head is shifting clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5251f232bfe77252fc5ee33af141317baffdc1e9601a2726955e564433804c15.png] 

Element with semi-circle is shifting anti-clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/195d6a7b25aa2656042cf4d64b0c482ebe8b8a850179a5c465a33cbe57e1cbad.png] 

**Note:** Each element is rotating by an angle of 180 degree everytime they shift their position.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
